CDP-enforced ranges: multiplier 2-32767, cyclecnt 1-32767, skipcycles 0-32767.

Raw refusals: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [b_start.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' (params 1-4 positional; 5 = -s splicelen, 6 = -m maxzig). seed (-r) not brk-probed (semantically meaningless); false.
dur is a FLOOR: outputs for dur=5 on a 2 s input ranged 5.25-7.64 s across seeds (+5% to +53%; can exceed dur + indur). Not predictable within 5% -> duration_row null.

DELIBERATE DEVIATION from the 'use static when unpredictable' rule: curated as set_by dur (documented lower bound) because static (= indur = 2 s) would under-predict a 5-8 s output far worse for pre-flight capping on an extend process. Flagged for integrator review.
Stochastic; -r seed reproduces exactly (verified). CAVEAT: unseeded runs are clock-seeded - two runs launched within the same second are byte-identical, which can fool naive determinism probes.
Seed hazard: -r7 on the canonical args aborts with 'ERROR: CANNOT ACHIEVE TASK: / ERROR: Final zig too short for splicelen.'
phase_sensitive true, stereo_link_default 'related'; stereo seed-linking machinery lands later (noted in known_issues).
Stereo input accepted -> 'any'.
Raw refusals: 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 1 [b_min.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' (params 1-3 positional; 4 = -w splen). seed (-s) not brk-probed; false.

set_by outdur: output overruns by up to one chunk (< maxseglen). Max observed 3.57% over 8 seeds with maxseglen 0.2 / outdur 5 (row params; worst-case bound 4%); 5.92% observed with maxseglen 0.3 / outdur 4 - row deliberately uses maxseglen << outdur.
Row is stochastic but the overrun bound (maxseglen/outdur = 4%) keeps it inside rel_tol 0.05 for any seed.
Stochastic; -s seed reproduces exactly (verified). Same clock-seeding caveat as zigzag (same-second runs identical).
Runtime input/splice-dependent bounds: minseglen 0.01 on 2 s file -> 'ERROR: Parameter[1] Value (0.010000) out of range (0.031000 to 1.985000)'.
-b / -e value-less switches not exposed per precedent.
phase_sensitive true, stereo_link_default 'related'; stereo seed-linking machinery lands later. Stereo input accepted -> 'any'.
